Specification: An algorithm by Lamport that computes a rooted spanning tree of an undirected graph. The state consists of a parent function mom and a distance function dist; on each step a node may lower its dist to any value strictly between its current dist and one more than a neighbor's dist, also updating its parent. A PostCondition characterizes terminal states, and Safety asserts that whenever Next is not enabled the PostCondition holds; Liveness asserts the algorithm eventually terminates.
AssumptionNames: /\ Root \in Nodes /\ \A e \in Edges : (e \subseteq Nodes) /\ (Cardinality(e) = 2) /\ MaxCardinality \in Nat /\ MaxCardinality >= Cardinality(Nodes)
IfThenElse: IF n = Root THEN 0 ELSE MaxCardinality
FunctionConstructor: [n \in Nodes |-> IF n = Root THEN 0 ELSE MaxCardinality]
FunctionConstructor_ByDomain: [n \in Nodes |-> IF n = Root THEN 0 ELSE MaxCardinality]
DivisionNotes: TemporalNesting is true because Safety expands to []((~ ENABLED Next) => PostCondition), an always over an implication into a state predicate, and WF_vars(Next) within Spec expands to nested temporal operators ([]<>).
Next is in ActionDefNames as the only action operator (it contains primed variables dist' and mom').
Nbrs and vars are placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef as structural value definitions used inside Init/Next; PostCondition and TypeOK are state predicates over current-state variables.
